NumericEntityUnescaper.replace:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Decode numeric character entities in a string, converting valid decimal or hexadecimal references into characters and returning the partially built output early on malformed input." replace]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> string </REF>: string "Input text to scan for numeric character entities."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "The decoded string, or the output accumulated up to the first malformed entity."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty output list, set the scan position to 0, and compute the input length from the string. RESULT out, pos, length]
            [COMMAND While the current position is less than length minus 2, examine the current and next characters for the numeric entity prefix. RESULT scan_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, if the current substring does not start with "&#", append the current character to the output and advance the position by 1. RESULT literal_copy]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, if the current substring starts with "&#", set the entity start index to pos + 2 and assume decimal parsing by default. RESULT start, is_hex]
            [COMMAND Within the entity branch, read the first character after "&#"; if it is "x" or "X", advance the start index by 1 and mark the entity as hexadecimal. RESULT start, is_hex]
            [COMMAND Within the entity branch after optional hexadecimal marker handling, if the start index equals the string length, return the joined output immediately. RESULT early_return]
            [COMMAND Within the entity branch, set the scan end index to start and advance it while it stays within bounds and the current character satisfies self.is_hex_char. RESULT end]
            [COMMAND Within the entity branch, if the scan end is within bounds and the current character is ";", attempt to convert the substring from start to end into an integer using base 16 when hexadecimal was detected, otherwise base 10. RESULT entity_value]
            [COMMAND Within the entity branch, if integer conversion fails, return the joined output immediately. RESULT early_return]
            [COMMAND Within the entity branch after successful conversion, append chr(entity_value) to the output, set pos to end plus 1, and continue the outer loop. RESULT out, pos]
            [COMMAND After the outer loop finishes, return the joined output string. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
NumericEntityUnescaper.is_hex_char:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Determine whether the input character is a decimal digit or a hexadecimal letter from a to f in a case-insensitive way." is_hex_char]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> char </REF>: string "Character value to test for hexadecimal validity."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True when the input is a decimal digit or a letter from a to f ignoring case, otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether char is a decimal digit using char.isdigit(). RESULT is_digit]
            [COMMAND If is_digit is True, return True immediately and skip all later checks because the or expression short-circuits. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND If is_digit is False, convert char to lowercase using char.lower(). RESULT lower_char]
            [COMMAND If is_digit is False, check whether lower_char is within the inclusive range from 'a' through 'f'. RESULT is_hex_letter]
            [COMMAND Return is_hex_letter as the final result when the digit check was False. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: char.isdigit() returns False.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Convert char to lowercase so uppercase hexadecimal letters can be evaluated using the same range bounds. RESULT lower_char]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether 'a' <= lower_char <= 'f' using inclusive boundaries where both 'a' and 'f' are accepted. RESULT is_hex_letter]
            [COMMAND Return True when is_hex_letter is True; otherwise return False. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
